Every country has its own culture. Culture shows
ways of living and thinking. In each culture, there
are rules that don’t allow certain things. So, we
need to know how to act in different countries.
Here are some unique and interesting rules from
around the world.
Switzerland: Let’s Care for Pets
In Switzerland, people really care about animals.
Swiss law says that people cannot have just one
hamster or one parrot at home. They must have at
least two. These pets feel lonely when they are
alone. They need a friend that can be with them.
Also, people who have dogs or cats must spend
enough time with their pets. Those who have dogs
must take them outside for exercise too. Pets are
very happy in Switzerland.
Singapore: Let’s Keep the City Clean
Singapore is a very clean city. Here, people cannot
eat or drink on buses or the subway. They also
cannot sell or import chewing gum. Those actions
can make the city dirty and messy. People who
break the rules must pay a fine. In Singapore,
everyone knows where to eat and where to throw
away their trash. Thanks to these rules, Singapore
remains very clean.
France: Let French Children Love Their Food
In France, children can’t have ketchup in school
cafeterias. This sounds surprising, but there’s a good
reason. France is famous for its delicious food.
French people are very proud of their food. They
believe that ketchup hides the real taste of their
food. They really hope that their children can taste
and enjoy the flavors of French cooking. That way,
French children can learn to love their food culture.
Which rule is most surprising? Maybe some rules
sound strange to you, but they show different
lifestyles around the world. Understanding different
rules from different countries helps us live together
more happily.
